column1: The emulated console's CPU. Higher can fix a game that slows down by itself, but costs this device's CPU. Lower can help heavy games; some then run wrong.

column1: Keeps the emulated CPU and GPU in step. Fixes crashes and glitches in a few games, costs speed.
column2: Mantém a CPU e a GPU emuladas em sincronia. Corrige travamentos e glitches em alguns jogos, mas custa velocidade.

column1: Accuracy vs speed. Some games read the picture back (aiming, lens flares); Fast skips that and breaks them.
column2: Precisão ou velocidade. Alguns jogos releem a imagem (mira, reflexos de lente); Rápido pula isso e os quebra.
